description: Source code implementing elliptic curve scalar operations in BoringSSL's FIPS module, including conversions, arithmetic, and Montgomery operations.

methods.name: ec_bignum_to_scalar
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to an EC_SCALAR, ensuring it is within the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_equal_vartime
methods.description: Checks if two EC_SCALAR values are equal in constant time.

methods.name: ec_scalar_is_zero
methods.description: Checks if an EC_SCALAR is zero.

methods.name: ec_random_nonzero_scalar
methods.description: Generates a random non-zero scalar within the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes an EC_SCALAR to big-endian bytes.

methods.name: ec_scalar_from_bytes
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into an EC_SCALAR, validating range.

methods.name: ec_scalar_reduce
methods.description: Reduces a scalar from Montgomery form modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_add
methods.description: Adds two EC_SCALAR values modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one EC_SCALAR from another modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_neg
methods.description: Negates an EC_SCALAR modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_select
methods.description: Selects between two EC_SCALAR values based on a mask.

methods.name: ec_scalar_to_montgomery
methods.description: Converts an EC_SCALAR to Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_scalar_from_montgomery
methods.description: Converts an EC_SCALAR from Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_scalar_mul_montgomery
methods.description: Multiplies two EC_SCALAR values in Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_simple_scalar_inv0_montgomery
methods.description: Computes the inverse of an EC_SCALAR in Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_simple_scalar_to_montgomery_inv_vartime
methods.description: Computes the inverse of an EC_SCALAR in Montgomery form in constant time.

methods.name: ec_scalar_inv0_montgomery
methods.description: Invokes the method to compute scalar inverse in Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_scalar_to_montgomery_inv_vartime
methods.description: Invokes the method to compute scalar inverse in Montgomery form in constant time.
